question: Draft a runbook for a batch ethanol fermentation in CEN.PK113-7D on glucose, using the extracted yield records and the Yeast9 glucose ceiling as a bound.

claims.text: Yeast9 flux balance ceiling for ethanol from glucose in the genome-scale model, an upper bound with no time axis or vessel, usable as the theoretical bound for the runbook

Ethanol yield on glucose extracted for CEN.PK113-7D from the paper on glycerol formation in a very high ethanol performance fed-batch process; the record is a fed-batch run, not a batch run, and its conditions field is empty

Ethanol yield on glucose extracted for CEN.PK113-7D from the paper on reducing glycerol formation capacity under anaerobic conditions; the source table describes anaerobic fed-batch fermentation, so this is not a batch run

passages.quote: Yields, concentrations, and specific rates are average values of 2 independent fermentations.

claims.text: Ethanol yield on glucose extracted for the parental CEN.PK113-7D strain in the adaptive laboratory evolution paper on ethanol tolerance; the record carries no conditions field, so the cultivation mode is not established from the corpus

gaps: draft_runbook was refused: there is no product 'ethanol' in the Dominion catalogue, and the Dominion module returned no ethanol molecule. No runbook was drafted and nothing was locked or published. A person with catalogue rights would need to add an ethanol product id before a runbook can be drafted.

No extracted yield record for CEN.PK113-7D on glucose is labelled as a batch run. The returned records are fed-batch (two papers) or of unstated mode (one paper). A batch-specific yield record is needed for the prediction.

All returned CEN.PK113-7D yield records have provenance unverified and an empty conditions field. Temperature, aeration, medium, pH and glucose concentration are not recorded for them, so they cannot anchor run settings.

The Yeast9 ceiling is for the S288C reference strain, not CEN.PK113-7D, and the model's ethanol route is the native pyruvate decarboxylase and alcohol dehydrogenase route. No CEN.PK113-7D-specific model or ceiling is on the shelf.
No batch growth or kinetic fit exists for CEN.PK113-7D in fermOS, and BioRepo returned no verified records, so no forecast or fitted time course can bound run length, biomass or product titre.
The runbook's start, mid-run and harvest measurements, and the sampling intervals, have not been specified by any source in the corpus; the bench protocol for CEN.PK113-7D batch ethanol is missing.
